spellbook.finance/limitations: Delegated writes require the workspace owner role, and membership remains backend-enforced.
Every call creates one NEW entry. It is not a desired total, so calling it twice with the same arguments records the purchase twice. Read spellbook_sealed_portfolio first when a retry is possible.
boxId must name a product already in the sealed catalog. An unknown id is refused, and spellbook_sealed_product_search resolves one.
A recorded price is the customer's own statement. SpellBook verifies no merchant order, no payment, and no delivery.

description: Record one sealed acquisition the customer has already made, so the buy can be scored later against what it cost. Names the catalog boxId, the quantity, the unit price paid as a decimal string, and the acquisition date. Use it after a seller buys a box, pack or case found through spellbook_sealed_deal_board. It records a purchase that happened; it never buys anything and moves no money.

acquisitionChannel.description: Where the product was bought, such as a store name or marketplace. Optional, and it is stored as the customer stated it.

acquisitionDate.description: The date the buy happened, as YYYY-MM-DD. Required, and it sets which day's modeled EV the purchase is scored against.

acquisitionPrice.description: Price paid PER UNIT in USD, as a decimal string such as "114.99". Not the order total. Required.

boxId.description: Exact sealed catalog product id, from spellbook_sealed_product_search or spellbook_sealed_deal_board. An id the catalog does not hold is refused. Required.

quantity.description: How many units of this product were bought. Required.

salesTaxUsd.description: Sales tax paid on the whole order in USD, as a decimal string. Optional.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to record this sealed buy in, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_portfolio_record
